k01.definition: Operating expenditure (Mengurus) spent by SPPE in the month.
k01.name: (a) Operasi

k02.definition: Development expenditure spent under the R&DCI allocation.
k02.evidence: Expenditure report or payment voucher list from Finance.
k02.name: (a) Pembangunan: R&DCI

k03.definition: Spending under the RKBSTAR joint venture (Usahasama) allocation.
k03.name: (a) Pembangunan: USAHASAMA RKBSTAR

k04.definition: Spending under the MPC–Steinbeis joint venture allocation.
k04.name: (a) Pembangunan: STEINBEIS

k05.definition: Revenue generated by SPPE (fees, sponsorship or paid services) received in the month.
k05.evidence: Receipt or revenue report from Finance.
k05.name: (a) Hasil di Jana

k06.definition: A training, workshop or course delivered by SPPE for external participants. Counted once per programme, on its date.
k06.evidence: Attendance list and programme agenda or report.
k06.name: (b) Program Pembangunan Kapasiti

k07.definition: A structured intervention that helps a client organisation improve its productivity (for example a productivity assessment followed by an improvement plan).
k07.name: (b) Program Peningkatan Produktiviti

k08.definition: An improvement or consultancy project delivered for a client organisation. Counted once, on the date the project is delivered.
k08.evidence: Project report, client letter or sign-off.
k08.name: (b) Projek Penambahbaikan/ Perundingan

k09.definition: Number of organisations that took part in SPPE programmes and projects. An organisation joining two programmes is counted twice.
k09.name: (b) Jumlah Organisasi

k10.definition: Government organisations (ministries, agencies, state governments, local authorities) among participating organisations.
k10.name: Kerajaan

k11.definition: Micro, small and medium enterprises among participating organisations, using the SME Corp definition.
k11.name: 20.2 Perusahaan Mikro, Kecil dan Sederhana (PMKS/ MSMEs)

k12.definition: Bumiputera-owned organisations among participating non-government organisations.
k12.evidence: Attendance list or registration form showing ownership.
k12.name: 21.1 Organisasi Bumiputera

k13.definition: Number of people attending SPPE client programmes (capacity-building and productivity programmes). A person attending two programmes is counted twice.
k13.name: (b) Jumlah Peserta

k15.definition: A policy paper, report or brief prepared by SPPE and formally submitted (for example to MITI, Kementerian Ekonomi or MPC management).
k15.evidence: The paper or a submission email or memo.
k15.name: (b) Kertas Dasar/ Laporan

k16.definition: A publication produced by SPPE, such as a report, bulletin or article, released to the public or stakeholders.
k16.evidence: Link to or copy of the publication.
k16.name: (c) Penerbitan

k17.definition: A media release issued for SPPE work.
k17.evidence: Link to or copy of the media release.
k17.name: (c) Media Release

k18.definition: An entry published in Diari MPC.
k18.evidence: Link to the Diari MPC entry.
k18.name: (c) Diari MPC

k19.definition: Video content produced and published for SPPE work.
k19.name: (c) Video Content

k20.definition: A poster or infographic produced and published.
k20.evidence: Image or link to the poster.
k20.name: (c) Poster

k21.definition: A system or application developed and launched by SPPE.
k21.name: (c) Sistem/ Aplikasi

k22.definition: An internal training session attended by SPPE staff.
k22.name: (d) Program (Dalaman)

k23.definition: Number of SPPE staff attendances at internal training. A staff member attending two sessions is counted twice.
k23.name: (d) Bilangan Peserta

k24.definition: Average training hours per SPPE staff member: total hours of all attendances divided by staff headcount (set in Settings).
k24.name: (d) Purata Jam Latihan Warga

k25.definition: Value created or cost saved for clients through SPPE work, as verified with the client.
k25.name: (e) Jangkaan Penciptaan Nilai & Penjimatan Kos dijana (RM)

k26.definition: Development expenditure spent under the NIMP (Program NIMP) allocation.
k26.evidence: Expenditure report or payment voucher list from Finance.
k26.name: (a) Pembangunan: NIMP
